outcome: Postoperative visual analogue scale (VAS) pain score
cohort: 100 patients undergoing spinal anaesthesia for caesarean section were randomly assigned to receive either a TAP block with 0.25% bupivacaine or normal saline.
finding: Ultrasound-guided bilateral TAP block with 0.25% bupivacaine significantly lowered postoperative VAS pain scores and reduced intravenous opioid (tramadol) consumption in patients undergoing caesarean section compared to those who received normal saline.
